points.description: States the property: a spanning tree has a single unique path between every pair of nodes / is loop-free while connecting all nodes, so no unnecessary duplicate packets are produced when forwarding along it. Equivalent wording accepted.

rubric.notes: Full mark for naming the loop-free / unique-path property (duplicates avoided is optional supporting detail). No mark for unrelated properties (e.g. only 'it is shorter' or 'it is a subnet'). The modification of Link State Routing is not covered by the model answer or marks.
